text: SAFETYNET headquarters, the Citadel. Every badge reader blinks red. Nobody looks at the person at the next desk.
Welcome back, Agent 0x00. Security posture is Level Red. I have logged your entry, your route, and the precise time you crossed the threshold. Everyone's, actually. It's rather the point.
I have also logged your kit. One pick set, one RFID cloner, one fingerprint kit.
The PIN device you are thinking of is still signed out to Agent 0x47, Nightshade, as it has been since St. Catherine's.
Read nothing into it. Vector has a hardware token out tonight, and Phantom a travel pack. Everyone on the planning list keeps something they shouldn't.
You are wondering what happened here. Portland happened. Four sites in one night, one team to send, and an enemy who had the deployment before we did.
The leak came from inside this building. Director Netherton has three names, and one of them got two of your colleagues killed.
A word of advice, from the only voice here with no stake in the outcome. The moment they know you are hunting, they vanish. Be quiet. Be quick.
The Director's office is north of this lobby. Do try not to trust anyone on the way.
